metadata.name: Allocation Slider – Split 100% Across Segments with Draggable Dividers and Locks
metadata.description: Allocation Slider for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): drag a divider between segments and its two neighbours trade share, so the total always stays at 100. It is built to make splitting a whole feel direct: only the two segments you move roll to new shares and amounts while the rest hold still. Locked segments are skipped over, minimums stop the drag, double-click evens neighbours, Reset restores the start. Controlled or uncontrolled, keyboard sliders with aria-valuetext, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for budgets, portfolio weights or team time. The included demo drags, locks and resets a monthly budget and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Avatar Status Ring – Presence Ring that Animates Speaking Level, Upload Progress and Status Changes
metadata.description: Avatar Status Ring for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): presence drawn as a ring instead of a dot — solid online, dashed away, red busy, thicker with the voice level while speaking, filling clockwise while uploading. It is built to show what a person is doing right now, animating every change in colour, dash pattern and thickness. Controlled status, level and progress props, tone overrides, silhouette fallback, aria-label, reduced motion, light and dark, and a stacked group. Use it for call grids, chat headers, team lists and voice agents. The included demo scripts a speaker and an upload and makes no network requests. Requires React and lucide-react only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Breakdown Stat Card – KPI Card that Splits a Number into Animated Segments
metadata.description: Breakdown Stat Card for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): a KPI tile whose big number opens like a drawer into its segments. The bar grows from the left, amounts roll up from zero, and hovering or focusing a segment rolls the headline value to its amount. It is built to show what a metric is made of without leaving the dashboard. Shares always sum to 100; expanded state and highlighted segment are controlled or uncontrolled. Roving-tabindex keyboard, polite announcements, light and dark, instant reduced motion. Use it for revenue, users, traffic or cost tiles. The included demo scripts two Alder tiles and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.

metadata.description: A highly polished, state-driven audio wave visualizer designed for AI voice interactions. Features seamless switching between 'listening', 'thinking', and 'speaking' states using hardware-accelerated fluid animations.

metadata.description: An ultra-clean, high-impact hero section powered by Framer Motion word-by-word blur-to-clear reveal animations, a mouse-reactive ambient spotlight, and crisp social proof avatars.

metadata.name: Modern AI SaaS Hero with Interactive Live Preview
metadata.description: A conversion-focused SaaS hero section featuring a subtle animated background grid, gradient badge, staggered text reveal, dual CTAs, and an interactive product preview frame.

metadata.description: A highly interactive form submission button built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Transitions smoothly through 'Idle', 'Loading' (with spinner), and 'Success' (with an animated checkmark) states.

metadata.name: Sleek AI Command Menu (CMDK) with Fuzzy Search
metadata.description: A premium, keyboard-accessible command menu dialog optimized for AI platforms. Features dynamic search filtering, shortcut key indicators, recent AI prompts history, and buttery smooth fade/scale transitions.

metadata.description: A responsive two-column hero section tailored for developer tools and APIs. Pairs bold value-proposition copy with an interactive tabbed code snippet terminal featuring one-click copy feedback.

metadata.name: Comparing Radio Cards – Plan Picker that Shows the Difference from Your Selection
metadata.description: Comparing Radio Cards for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): plan cards in a radio group where the selected card lifts forward and the others show their difference from it as chips (+$12/mo, +200 GB). It is built to answer "what changes if I pick this one" without a table. On a new pick the ring slides over, the detail unfolds and chips roll to the new baseline. Real radio inputs, controlled or uncontrolled value, numeric attributes with betterDirection, a live summary, light and dark, instant under reduced motion. Use it for pricing plans, storage tiers, shipping or seats. The included demo scripts three Alder plans and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Delta Number Ticker – Rolling Number with Animated Change Chip and Previous Value
metadata.description: Delta Number Ticker for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): digits roll on every change while a chip with the absolute and percent change lifts off the number and settles beside it, and the old value lingers below as a ghost. It is built to show how much and which way a figure moved. Columns roll with a 20 ms stagger, new columns grow in for extra digits, and goodDirection paints a falling latency as good. Controlled previousValue or own memory, Intl formatting, polite announcements, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for KPIs, prices, balances, latency and stock. The included demo plays a fixed storefront scenario and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Drag Select Checkbox Group – Press and Drag to Check Multiple Rows in One Stroke
metadata.description: Drag Select Checkbox Group for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): press one checkbox and drag to check every row you pass in one stroke; back up and the passed rows are restored. It is built to make bulk selection one gesture instead of many clicks. A translucent band follows the pointer, ticks draw themselves and select-all shows a mixed state. Shift+click ranges, arrow keys, Ctrl/⌘+A, touch long-press, controlled or uncontrolled value, aria labels, reduced motion and light/dark are included. Use it for mail, files, members and tables. The included demo is a mock inbox with embedded headshots and makes no network requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Early Access Pass CTA – Email Signup Section that Issues a Holographic Pass
metadata.description: Early Access Pass CTA for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): an email signup section that issues a membership-style pass on submit, printing the name, rolling the number up and stamping the date. It is built to turn a signup into something visitors can hold. The pass tilts toward the pointer with a moving sheen; the form validates the address, shows Try again when the promise rejects and announces the issue politely. Controlled or uncontrolled pass, split or stacked layout, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for waitlists, newsletters, betas and event registration. The included demo types, issues, retries once and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Expiring Badge – Status Badge with a Time Rim that Empties and Morphs to Expired
metadata.description: Expiring Badge for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): a status badge whose rim shows the share of time left and empties as time passes, turns amber, then red, and morphs its label to Expired. It is built to show how long a trial, offer or code has left. Pass expiresAt with startedAt or duration; the label can be a function of the time left, live mode rolls its digits each second, onExpire fires once, now() is injectable. Focusable with a tooltip, polite expiry announcement, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for trials, sales, New labels, codes and sessions. The included demo shows five badges on an account card and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: First Item Empty State – Empty List that Turns into Your First Row
metadata.description: First Item Empty State for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): an empty list whose placeholder rows become the first real row on Create. It is built to make the moment after Create feel continuous: the row lifts out of the ghost layer, the title types in, the pill lands, the copy folds into a toolbar and the rest collapse. onCreate returns an item or a promise; a rejection shows Try again. Controlled or uncontrolled items, renderItem, keyboard support, a live region, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for the first screen of projects, clients or files. The included demo creates two projects, fails once and retries, and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Live Activity Dock – Dock Navigation with Progress Rings and Expanding Live Cards
metadata.description: Live Activity Dock for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): dock tiles carry live state — progress ring, rolling badge, running dot, error shake — and grow a live card out of the tile with title, percent, time left and actions. It is built to show how far a task has got without leaving the page. The icon flies into the card, other tiles dim, Escape closes it. Controlled or uncontrolled expandedId, animated progress and badge updates. Keyboard, aria, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for exports, uploads, sync and builds. The included demo scripts an export, a badge change and a failed upload with retry, and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Natural Language Date Picker – Type "next fri 3pm" and the Calendar Follows
metadata.description: Natural Language Date Picker for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): type "next fri 3pm" or "in 2 weeks" and the calendar follows. It is built to let people write dates as they say them: a chip shows the reading after a short pause, the calendar turns to its month, the day pulses and Enter confirms. The grammar is an exported pure parseNaturalDate(text, now) with no date library. Controlled or uncontrolled, onValueChange with its source, min/max dates, a keyboard-driven role="grid" calendar, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for due dates, reminders and filters. The included demo types three phrases on a fixed clock and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Progressive Sign Up Form – Fields Appear as You Go, No Steps
metadata.description: Progressive Sign Up Form for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): one card that starts with an email field and grows the next field only when the previous one is valid, with no step pages. The name slides in under a valid email, the password brings a four-segment strength meter that fills rule by rule, and the terms row arrives as the button morphs from Continue to Create account. Earlier fields stay editable. An async onSubmit fills the button, then the card morphs into a welcome state or offers Try again. Use it for SaaS onboarding and newsletter sign-ups. The demo types a sign-up, fails once and retries, with no requests. Requires React only.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Rail Panel Sidebar – Icon Rail with Context Panels, Pin to Collapse and Hover Peek
metadata.description: Rail Panel Sidebar for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): an icon rail plus a context panel per section. It is built to show where you just went: the active marker slides along the rail and the panel content enters from the direction of travel. Unpin it and the panel folds into the rail; hover or focus the rail and the panel peeks over the content as a floating layer. Controlled or uncontrolled activeId, pinned and peeking, arrow keys, Enter and Escape, aria-current, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for workspace app shells. The included demo plays a scripted tour on local data and makes no network requests (inline avatars). Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Read Along Text – Word Highlight Synced to Speech or Audio Progress
metadata.description: Read Along Text for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): a paragraph whose words light up in time with speech, the current word lifted on a soft highlight with a caret under it and a breath after punctuation. It is built to show listeners where the voice is, so a transcript can be followed and tapped. It owns no clock: drive it with progress or currentTime, or use playing with wordsPerSecond. Click or Enter on a word calls onSeek, arrow keys move between words, reduced motion keeps colors only. Use it for AI voice answers, transcripts and read-aloud modes. The included demo plays a fake voice reply and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Scrub Pagination – Drag a Track to Scrub Pages, Ellipsis Morphs into Jump Input
metadata.description: Scrub Pagination for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): page numbers over a thin track that scrubs hundreds of pages at once. It is built to reach page 37 of 120 in one drag. A click slides the pill and rolls the numbers; the dragged handle shows a live “Page 37 / 120” tooltip and snaps on release; the ellipsis morphs into a jump field. onPageChange fires only on commit while onScrub reports the live page; controlled or uncontrolled, a keyboard role="slider" handle, aria-current, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for data tables, search results and log viewers. The included demo pages through 720 invoices and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Status Dropdown Select – Status and Priority Picker where the Chosen Dot Flies to the Trigger
metadata.description: Status Dropdown Select for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): a status picker whose chosen dot, icon or photo flies from the list to the trigger, tinting the pill and rolling the label on landing. It is built to make a change in a row readable at a glance. Portal listbox with groups, shortcuts, type-ahead and arrow keys; opens upward when space is short. Controlled or uncontrolled, dot, icon or avatar kinds, full ARIA, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for issue status, priority, assignees and orders. The included demo plays pointer and keyboard scenes, stops when you interact, uses embedded headshots and makes no network requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.name: Wordmark Reveal Footer – Giant Logo Footer with Reflection, Status and Local Time
metadata.description: Wordmark Reveal Footer for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): a footer whose giant wordmark rises letter by letter through the floor line, lights a reflection, then switches on a status band with live local time per office. It is built to close a page with a brand moment that feels alive instead of a static logo. Props: brand, columns, newsletter, socials, legal, status tone, offices with IANA time zones, reflection, reveal on mount, in view or manual, controlled revealed with onRevealEnd. Landmarks, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for SaaS, studio and agency sites. The included demo replays the reveal once and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy

metadata.description: A rounded button with a glossy top-light gradient and inset sheen, built on Base UI's Button primitive with size variants.
